title: Esho Maa Lakshmi
desc: Devotees celebrate Goddess Lakshmi with prayers, rituals and heartfelt devotion, seeking prosperity, blessings and harmony in their homes and lives.

title: Mem Saheb
desc: Kajal falls in love with Amit, an unemployed journalist. She urges him to focus on his career and provides unconditional support, but destiny has other plans for the couple.

title: Loafer
desc: Bikram is a selfless man who is unfairly hated by his family. However, after an arrest for helping a friend marry, he struggles to gain the respect of those he constantly protects.

title: Putuler Protisodh
desc: Bini, a married woman, is murdered by her in-laws, following which her spirit possesses a doll. As she decides to seek revenge, her husband's second wife must free her spirit.

title: Anjali
desc: A devout father arranges his daughter's marriage with a renowned businessman. However, the daughter secretly resents the union as she is madly in love with her boyfriend.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Laxmi, a milkmaid, falls in love with Kanchan, an influential zamindar's son. Things take a tragic turn when his family disapproves of their alliance.
